cards.concept: Support and resistance as testable locations
cards.definition_principle: A support or resistance level is a candidate location where an existing trend may be interrupted; current use requires an exact numeric level and observed interaction.
measurable_predicates: completed candle reaches the declared tolerance
post-touch continuation or interruption window is fixed before evaluation
valid_conditions: Instrument, timeframe, level, tolerance, and evaluation window are fixed before the outcome.
failure_conditions: Level is redrawn after the outcome or inferred only from a screenshot.
contradictions: Published level performance varied by source and market in the cited study.
when_not_to_use: Do not use a location alone as direction, probability, or entry authorization.
cards.short_excerpt: points at which an exchange rate trend may be interrupted and reversed
cards.paraphrase: Treat support/resistance as a predeclared testable location, not a guaranteed reversal.

cards.concept: Level strength labels are not probabilities
cards.definition_principle: A qualitative strength rating attached to a level must not be treated as calibrated likelihood without independent outcome validation.
measurable_predicates: strength label retained as source metadata
CITADEL historical probability remains null unless calibration policy passes
valid_conditions: The label is shown only as explanatory metadata.
failure_conditions: Strength language is mapped to confidence or win probability.
contradictions: The cited study found reported strength categories had no consistent correspondence with bounce frequency.
when_not_to_use: Do not rank live trades by an unvalidated strong/weak label.
cards.exact_locator: PDF p.64 > reported strength ratings conclusion
cards.short_excerpt: reported strength levels seem to have no consistent correspondence
cards.paraphrase: Keep qualitative level strength separate from calibrated empirical probability.

cards.definition_principle: Because geometric chart interpretation is subjective, any CITADEL pattern claim must compile to repeatable numerical predicates before it can become evidence.
measurable_predicates: same candles and policy produce the same label
predicate version and tolerances are recorded
forming candles cannot confirm the pattern
valid_conditions: The claim is reproducible without discretionary redrawing.
failure_conditions: Only a visual name or hindsight-selected geometry is available.
contradictions: Objective recognition does not establish profitability or transfer across markets.
when_not_to_use: Do not let an LLM or screenshot name a live pattern as verified evidence.
cards.paraphrase: Convert subjective chart geometry into versioned, automatic, reproducible predicates.

cards.concept: Technical information is not a live edge claim
cards.definition_principle: Evidence that some historical technical indicators contained incremental information does not establish that a current intraday option setup has an edge.
measurable_predicates: current evidence is separated from source-study results
historical_probability is null without CITADEL OOS calibration
valid_conditions: The source is used only to motivate measurable research.
failure_conditions: Study findings are copied into current confidence or probability.
contradictions: The cited results came from a different instrument universe, frequency, and historical period.
when_not_to_use: Do not cite the study as proof that a current pattern will work.
cards.paraphrase: Use technical studies to define hypotheses; use CITADEL OOS outcomes to validate them.
